title: RideOption
description: A specific ride-hailing vehicle category and pricing option presented to a passenger in response to a ride request. v2.1 adds V1 ONDC TRV10 fields from both the fulfillment and item to enable lossless round-trip migration.

RideOptionFeature.description: A named feature and its value for display to the customer.

featureName.description: Display name of the feature (e.g. AC). Maps to V1 FEATURE_LIST.FEATURE_NAME.

featureValue.description: Value of the feature (e.g. true). Maps to V1 FEATURE_LIST.FEATURE_VALUE.

RideOptionCancellationTerm.description: A cancellation policy term linked to a specific fulfillment state.

fulfillmentStateCode.description: The fulfillment state at which this cancellation term applies.

reasonRequired.description: Whether a reason must be provided when cancelling at this state.

vehicleType.description: Category of vehicle for this ride option

estimatedArrival.description: Estimated vehicle arrival time at the pickup point

pricingModel.description: Fare policy and pricing rules for this ride option.

tags.description: V1-compatible tag groups preserved verbatim for lossless V2→V1 round-trip.

vehicle.description: Vehicle attributes for this ride option. Maps to V1 fulfillment.vehicle.* and VEHICLE_INFO tag entries.

serviceClass.description: Service class attributes for this ride option. Maps to V1 fulfillment.tags[VEHICLE_INFO] and item.descriptor.code.

fulfillmentType.description: Fulfillment delivery type for this ride option (e.g. DELIVERY). Maps to V1 fulfillment.type.

tipOptions.description: JSON-encoded array of tip amounts available for the customer. Maps to V1 items[].tags[INFO].TIP_OPTIONS.

isBlockedSearchRoute.description: Whether this ride option is currently blocked for the searched route. Maps to V1 items[].tags[INFO].IS_BLOCKED_SEARCH_ROUTE.

isCustomerPreferredSearchRoute.description: Whether this matches a customer-preferred route. Maps to V1 items[].tags[INFO].IS_CUSTOMER_PREFFERED_SEARCH_ROUTE.

featureList.description: Ordered list of display-visible feature name/value pairs. Maps to V1 items[].tags[FEATURE_LIST].

cancellationTerms.description: Per-state cancellation policy for this ride option. Maps to V1 item.cancellation_terms[].

upgradeToVehicleClass.description: Whether the customer can upgrade to a higher vehicle class. Maps to V1 items[].tags[GENERAL_INFO].UPGRADE_TO_CAB.

etaToNearestDriverMin.description: Estimated time in minutes until the nearest available driver arrives. Maps to V1 items[].tags[GENERAL_INFO].ETA_TO_NEAREST_DRIVER_MIN.

distanceToNearestDriverMeter.description: Distance in metres to the nearest available driver. Maps to V1 items[].tags[GENERAL_INFO].DISTANCE_TO_NEAREST_DRIVER_METER.

isInsured.description: Whether this ride is covered by insurance. Maps to V1 items[].tags[INSURANCE_INFO].IS_INSURED.

insuredAmount.description: The insurance coverage amount for this ride. Maps to V1 items[].tags[INSURANCE_INFO].INSURED_AMOUNT.

displayBookingId.description: Human-readable booking reference shown to the customer. Maps to V1 items[].tags[BOOKING_INFO].DISPLAY_BOOKING_ID.
